title: Looking for an older rpg maker game with an archer main character

posts.author: Traveling Bard
posts.body:
I can't remember the name of the rpg maker game but I do remember that it had a main character with blonde hair and red color scheme that was an archer, a female knight that was sort of the tank, and eventually there was a guy in a black cloak and black hat that possibly used hatchets? I want to say that the game had a name that was a play on Final Fantasy, like Last Story but that's an actual Wii game made by Mistwalker
I'm on a mission to find this game so I can go back and beat it. I want to say that it was likely made in rpg maker xp or earlier since it was from the old days. Anyone know what it's called and possibly know where I can download it? Thanks in advance!

posts.author: Blackfield
posts.body: Ara Fell checks some boxes but not all so probably not this one?

posts.author: Traveling Bard
posts.body:
Thanks for pointing these two out but unfortunately no. I'm pretty sure it never got big enough to launch on steam. It felt pretty well polished with original art for the characters. But it was freeware long ago. I recall the blonde male MC having a hero/justice complex, the female knight being middle aged with a husband at home... and the guy in black was hunting them. I think there was a third character I'm forgetting that the guy in black was hunting in particular.
The guy in black had an almost Raidou from Devil Summoner look haha That's about all I've got from a game I probably played a decade ago. Might be a lost cause tbh...
